correctness.rationale: All 15751 K-rational projective points and all 15751 dual lines are explicitly enumerated over irreducible F5 cubics. Direct field-equation evaluation gives 136 curve points and the complete line histogram; incidence with the 120 six-secants yields the exact four-value point spectrum. A second independent finite-field representation generates every candidate six-secant from pairs of curve points and confirms all numbers. Line-point and pair-point identities and the line configuration intersection identity are checked; no unsampled or infinite claim is made.

value.rationale: The direct 2023 motivating paper leaves the r=3 rational BKS completeness case unresolved. For the naturally defined q=5 instance, exact external holes (6555), line-character census, and rigid 120-line intersection pattern give a nontrivial finite case classification. The results sharpen general geometric knowledge and inform extension of naturally arising near-MDS arc configurations, without pretending to yield a general prime-power theorem.
